user.title: Register EV Charging Station
user.description: Enter your data.go.kr API key, then select a region and enter a station name or address keyword to search. You can also enter a Station ID (statId) directly if known.

select_station.title: Select Charging Stations
select_station.description: Select one or more charging stations from the search results.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the API server.
error.station_not_found: No chargers found for the given Station ID.
error.no_stations_found: No charging stations matched your region and keyword.
error.no_station_selected: Select at least one charging station.
error.missing_search_or_id: Enter a search keyword or a Station ID (statId).

abort.already_configured: This charging station is already configured.

interval.title: Polling Interval
interval.description: When automatic adjustment is enabled, the polling interval scales automatically based on the number of registered stations and the daily API limit.

data.auto_interval: Auto-adjust polling interval by station count (Recommended)
data.scan_interval: Manual polling interval (minutes, when auto is off)

add_station.title: Search Stations to Add
add_station.description: Select a region and enter a keyword to search for more stations.

add_station_select.title: Select Stations to Add
add_station_select.description: Select one or more stations to add.

manage_stations.title: Manage Registered Stations
manage_stations.description: Keep checked stations; unchecked stations will be removed.
